goal: VII consumes supplier API data through one loss-safe canonical catalog and exposes consistent vacation and event content without relying on the legacy site.

intent_model.literal_request: Complete the API logic, test 10 vacation and 10 event places, fix discrepancies and retest until zero observed errors.
intent_model.implied_outcome: The new public platform remains correct after the legacy domain disappears and future partial supplier refreshes cannot silently damage content.
likely_rejections: A partial API payload erased accepted content
The result was not verified publicly

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Cover the shared ingestion boundary and every affected public consumer
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Full affected-family checks plus natural-destination proof

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Zero observed mismatches in the defined final sample, not an unprovable guarantee for all future inputs
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: All 20 sampled places and both search modes must pass after the final repair cycle

cognitive_flow.current_decision: Reject partial content erosion and preserve the last accepted generation
cognitive_flow.next_action: Implement the shared guard and execute focused tests

predictive_preflight.no_applicable_lessons_reason: No verified applicable lesson was loaded; missing project sources were not invented.

natural_destination: Public VII vacation and event pages and searches

A partial candidate cannot erase populated galleries, rooms, grouped facilities or room content

Ten vacation and ten event places plus dated and undated searches finish with zero observed mismatches
Only an exact verified candidate may be published and rollback identity remains available

open_questions.question: Does the supplier expose explicit deletion tombstones for individual nested fields?
open_questions.resolution: Until documented, destructive absence is quarantined rather than accepted

authorization_boundary: Local implementation, testing and release preparation are authorized. No production data/schema/secret/environment mutation. Publication only through the approved Sites route after duplicate and uncertain-operation checks.
